Class CSVReader

java.lang.Object
org.example.CSVReader
public class CSVReader extends Object
Utility class for reading data from CSV files and converting them into structured Java objects.

This class includes various methods to process CSV files representing different types of data, such as articles, machines, items, operations, and Bill of Operations (BOO) data. It provides flexible functionality for parsing and handling errors during file reading.

    • readArticlesFromCSV

      public static List<Article> readArticlesFromCSV(String filePath)
      Reads a list of articles from a CSV file.

      Each line is processed using the Article.fromCSV(String) method to instantiate an Article object. Skips the header line in the file.

      Parameters:
      filePath - the path to the CSV file containing article data
      Returns:
      a list of Article objects

    • readBooFromCSV

      public static BooDataResult readBooFromCSV(String filePath, Map<Integer,Integer> operationToItemMap)
      Reads Bill of Operations (BOO) data from a CSV file.

      Processes lines to populate the booData map with operation-to-suboperation relationships and the itemQuantities map with item quantities. Additionally, updates the provided operationToItemMap for operation-to-item mappings. Skips the header line in the file.

      Parameters:
      filePath - the path to the CSV file containing BOO data
      operationToItemMap - a map to populate with operation-to-item mappings
      Returns:
      a BooDataResult object containing parsed BOO data and item quantities
